description: The file defines AttractionsActivity, an Android activity responsible for displaying a grid of nearby attractions on a wearable device. It manages UI components like ViewPager, page indicators, and handles data fetching from the Google Wearable DataApi, including connection management, data parsing, and populating attraction objects. It also implements gesture detection for user interaction.

classes.name: AttractionsActivity
classes.description: Main activity for displaying attraction details in a grid view on a wearable device, handling UI setup, data fetching from the Wearable DataApi, gesture detection, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, window insets handling, gesture detector, and starts async data fetch if URI is provided.

methods.name: dispatchTouchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches touch events, integrating gesture detection.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events, integrating gesture detection.
